name: Reconnaissance
overview: The biblical account of reconnaissance in Joshua 2 reveals the strategic and secretive nature of gathering intelligence before entering enemy territory. Joshua sent two men to spy on Jericho, where they found refuge in Rahab's house, highlighting the importance of discretion and divine providence in their mission. The king of Jericho's awareness of the spies underscores the risks involved, while Rahab's protection of them demonstrates faith and courage amid danger.
